orientation: arched hanging torso with descending hips and legs
pose: User photo governs curved spinal and torso shape; chest up, head following sagittal backward arch, pelvis and legs descending freely. Never constrain this movement to a rigid body line.
prompt:
Create one photorealistic Strength Ledger movement artwork candidate: STERNUM CHIN-UP, at the top of the pull.

Bent arms pull elbows downward and behind the ribs; supinated chin-up grip. Lower chest/sternum reaches the straight chin-up bar. Feet hang clear of the floor. The shoulders, pelvis, and feet are NOT a single straight line.
Use the low side-three-quarter viewpoint of the pose photo so the arch and chest-to-bar relationship are obvious, but pull back enough to include the entire person, both hands and both feet. Use a real solid black bolted power rack with a structurally supported straight chin-up bar; uprights beside the athlete do not obscure the torso. Hands genuinely grasp the bar. No floating hardware.
Render the approved studio family: near-black background, dark rubber floor, natural skin texture, soft neutral upper-left key and restrained violet edge light. Preserve the male athlete and clothing from image 1; do not transfer the gym, logos, blue clothing, or subject identity from image 2. Square canvas, clear margins, premium realistic exercise photography, no text, no diagram.
